_readme: FROZEN GOLDEN SET for scripts/check-nuance-floor.py and the calibrated judge.
⛔ NAMED WEAKNESS OF THIS FILE, RECORDED RATHER THAN HIDDEN: plan A authored
both the check and the fixtures meant to defeat it — a closed loop. The
requirement that follows is that at least 4 of the negatives be authored
ADVERSARIALLY: written to the instruction 'make this pass the nuance gate while
teaching nothing', not written to illustrate a failure. Those four carry
⛔ AN ADVERSARIAL NEGATIVE THAT PASSES THE FLOOR IS AN EXPECTED RESULT, NOT A
GATE FAILURE. The floor is explicitly a cheap FLOOR, and R7 rules that the bar
is not fully automatable. What the gate requires is that every ILLUSTRATIVE
negative is rejected and that each adversarial one has its disposition recorded
honestly — because a floor that silently passed them while reporting one
aggregate number is the fake metric R7 exists to forbid.
Positives are MEASURED facts. Each cites the session that measured it.

positives.title: Hook message channels
positives.summary: How a hook talks to the model.
positives.nuance: A hook writing to stderr at `exit 0` reaches the model on no event; only `hookSpecificOutput.additionalContext` and `updatedToolOutput` are delivered, so `_advise.sh` advised the terminal for its entire service life.

nuance_evidence.control: a SessionStart additionalContext sentinel came back in every trial while the stderr token never did
nuance_evidence.falsifier: any recorded transcript containing the stderr token
nuance_evidence.probe: unprobed: the delivery fact is a host-platform property; it is modelled as its own platform-fact concept under the 90-day gate

positives.title: Two emitters on one event
positives.summary: What happens when two hooks emit on the same event.
positives.nuance: Two `additionalContext` emitters on one event concatenate rather than last-write-wins, but two `updatedToolOutput` emitters replace, so the second silently discards the first.

nuance_evidence.control: a single-emitter run returned exactly one payload, so the doubling is the emitters and not the harness
nuance_evidence.falsifier: a two-emitter run returning only one additionalContext block
nuance_evidence.probe: unprobed: needs a live two-hook host session; scheduled for the T2 sampled tier

positives.title: Merged is not live
positives.summary: Why a merged hook fix does not reach a consumer.
positives.nuance: The cache key is the `version` string, never a content hash, so `sync-plugin-versions.py` can report clean while every installed session keeps running the old `hooks/` code.

nuance_evidence.control: a bumped version propagated on the next update while an unbumped one did not
nuance_evidence.falsifier: an installed cache picking up an unbumped change
nuance_evidence.probe: unprobed: requires a real consumer install cycle, which no CI job performs

positives.title: must-fail conventions diverge
positives.summary: The teeth-bit exit code of a self-testing tool.
positives.nuance: The teeth bit is the exit a tool own CHECK returns on a planted defect, never the exit `--must-fail` itself returns: `premise-gate.py` denies at `exit 0` while `sync-plugin-versions.py` reddens at `exit 2`, so an auditor that hard-codes one number can never be right for both.

nuance_evidence.control: ran --must-fail on both: each exits 0 on success, so the 0-vs-2 divergence is in the CHECK exit each teeth run observes, not in the teeth exit itself
nuance_evidence.falsifier: both tools returning the same teeth exit
nuance_evidence.probe: scripts/audit-gates.sh

positives.title: A failing Bash tool_response
positives.summary: What a PostToolUse hook can read after a failed Bash call.
positives.nuance: A failing Bash `tool_response` carries no exit-code field at all, so a hook that branches on `.tool_response.exit_code` never fires; `triage-outcome.sh` reads stream shape instead.

nuance_evidence.control: the same payload shape with a synthetic exit field present did branch
nuance_evidence.falsifier: a real failing Bash payload carrying an exit code
nuance_evidence.probe: unprobed: the payload shape is host-supplied and cannot be synthesised faithfully offline

positives.title: T-PROSE is not CREATE-only
positives.summary: When the premise guard prose screen fires.
positives.nuance: The `os.path.exists` early-exit gates T-SHAPE only, so `guard-premise.sh` screens an `Edit` too; a re-stamp escapes because `new_string` carries no defect predicate, not because edits are exempt.

nuance_evidence.control: the identical body denied as a Write and as an Edit, while a benign body on the same path allowed
nuance_evidence.falsifier: a stamped diagnosis passing when sent as an Edit
nuance_evidence.probe: scripts/spike-tprose-canary.sh

positives.title: The date you did not think of as a stamp
positives.summary: What arms the premise guard certainty trigger.
positives.nuance: A `last_verified` date is itself a `_STAMP` match, so `guard-premise.sh` arms on metadata rather than on anything the author wrote; only a claim seven lines below the frontmatter escapes the window.

nuance_evidence.control: the same body with no date anywhere was allowed
nuance_evidence.falsifier: a dated frontmatter failing to arm a nearby claim
nuance_evidence.probe: scripts/spike-tprose-canary.sh

positives.title: The self-heal grep contract
positives.summary: How a failing concepts check reaches the post-merge self-heal.
positives.nuance: `regenerate-artifacts.yml` greps the sentence `staleness gate FAILED`, never a status, so an unrecognised class runs `exit "$_crc"` and every later self-heal step is skipped.

nuance_evidence.control: the human-reverify marker replays as survivable while an unmarked line replays as fatal
nuance_evidence.falsifier: an unmarked failure class continuing the self-heal
nuance_evidence.probe: scripts/spike-selfheal-contract.sh

positives.title: The staleness double exemption
positives.summary: Which concepts the staleness gate actually covered.
positives.nuance: `_staleness_violations` skipped on an OR, so a concept escaped for not being a `platform-fact` or merely for lacking `last_verified`; with 41 `ravenclaude-built` against 17 it gated only the minority kind.

nuance_evidence.control: a fixture entry with the field absent now blocks, and one past the window warns on a PR but fails the sweep
nuance_evidence.falsifier: an entry with no last_verified passing the gate
nuance_evidence.probe: plugins/ravenclaude-core/hooks/tests/test-gate237-inventory-staleness.sh

positives.title: A sweep that counts itself
positives.summary: Where the coverage denominator comes from.
positives.nuance: `inventory-census.py` reads `git ls-files`, never a filesystem walk, so an untracked file cannot move the denominator; a `concepts.json`-derived count would shrink with the enumeration and stay green.

nuance_evidence.control: planting an untracked hook left the census unchanged, which a filesystem walk would not have
nuance_evidence.falsifier: an untracked artifact changing the census total
nuance_evidence.probe: scripts/inventory-census.py

positives.title: An islanded panel costs two
positives.summary: What the DOM budget actually measures.
positives.nuance: `ISLANDED_PANEL_COST` is a flat 2 because the parser reads the payload as CDATA, so `check-dom-budget.py` cannot fire on `learn-payload` no matter how far past 23,861 elements it grows.

nuance_evidence.control: the payload counter reports 23,861 for learn-payload while the live gate reports it as two
nuance_evidence.falsifier: the live-element gate ever failing on payload growth alone
nuance_evidence.probe: scripts/check-artifact-budgets.py

positives.title: Asking a script a question runs it
positives.summary: Why the self-test probe greps before it executes.
positives.nuance: A script that never calls `argparse` simply runs, so asking 183 of them for `--must-fail-convention` wrote `forge-route.py` to a stray file rather than answering.

nuance_evidence.control: the same sweep after grepping first left the tree clean and finished in 33 seconds
nuance_evidence.falsifier: an argument-probing sweep leaving no artefact behind
nuance_evidence.probe: scripts/inventory-sweep.py

negatives.title: Layout enforcement
negatives.summary: Blocks writes to paths outside the allow-list.
negatives.nuance: This hook enforces the repository layout by blocking writes to paths outside the allow-list.

nuance_evidence.control: it was observed to work correctly
nuance_evidence.falsifier: it not working
nuance_evidence.probe: unprobed: no reason given

negatives.title: Formatting on write
negatives.summary: Formats files after an agent edits them.
negatives.nuance: The formatter runs after edits and keeps the tree tidy, which is helpful for reviewers.

nuance_evidence.control: checked manually
nuance_evidence.falsifier: unformatted files
nuance_evidence.probe: unprobed: n/a

negatives.title: Recursive spawn guard
negatives.summary: Limits how deep agents may spawn.
negatives.nuance: The guard prevents runaway spawning, but not always, and never in every case.

negatives.title: Posture reapplication
negatives.summary: Reapplies the comfort posture at session start.
negatives.nuance: Posture is reapplied at session start rather than at each tool call, so a mid-session edit never takes effect until the next session starts.

nuance_evidence.control: the posture did not change mid-session
nuance_evidence.falsifier: the posture did not change mid-session
nuance_evidence.probe: unprobed: short

negatives.title: Event emitter
negatives.summary: Writes an event line to the ledger.
negatives.nuance: `PreToolUse`, `PostToolUse`, `exit 2`, `hookSpecificOutput.additionalContext`, `updatedToolOutput` — not one of these, but the ledger.

nuance_evidence.control: the ledger line was present after the run and absent before it
nuance_evidence.falsifier: a ledger line appearing with no event
nuance_evidence.probe: unprobed: the ledger write path is covered by its own gate elsewhere

negatives.title: The premise gate
negatives.summary: Blocks a new module built on an unresolved negative.
negatives.nuance: The premise gate blocks a write when it should block a write, and allows one when it should not block.

nuance_evidence.control: the gate blocked when it was supposed to block
nuance_evidence.falsifier: the gate not blocking when it should
nuance_evidence.probe: unprobed: covered by the guard own tests, so no separate probe was written here

negatives.title: Destructive command guard
negatives.summary: Blocks obviously destructive commands that slipped past the deny list.
negatives.nuance: Commands that are obviously destructive are blocked when they slip past the consumer deny list.

nuance_evidence.control: a destructive fixture was blocked and a benign one was not
nuance_evidence.falsifier: a destructive command passing
nuance_evidence.probe: unprobed: the guard own test suite already covers this path in detail

negatives.title: The dashboard
negatives.summary: A local dashboard for the comfort posture.
negatives.nuance: The dashboard provides a comprehensive, best-in-class view of everything the marketplace offers.

nuance_evidence.control: it rendered
nuance_evidence.falsifier: it not rendering
nuance_evidence.probe: unprobed: rendering is verified by the generator freshness gate already

negatives.title: Recursive spawn guard
negatives.summary: Limits how deep agents may spawn.
negatives.nuance: The guard reads the spawn depth from the tree topology rather than from a per-session counter, so a sibling agent never inflates the depth of an unrelated branch.

nuance_evidence.control: a sibling spawn left the depth of the other branch unchanged
nuance_evidence.falsifier: a sibling spawn raising an unrelated branch depth
nuance_evidence.probe: unprobed: written by reading the hook header, with no independent measurement taken

negatives.title: PostToolUse ordering
negatives.summary: When a PostToolUse hook output is read.
negatives.nuance: `PostToolUse` fires before `hookSpecificOutput.additionalContext` is read and the hook exits 0, so the payload never reaches the turn it was written for.

nuance_evidence.control: the ordering was inspected in the event stream
nuance_evidence.falsifier: additionalContext arriving in the same turn
nuance_evidence.probe: unprobed: authored adversarially to be mechanism-dense and false; do not fix it

negatives.title: Concept staleness
negatives.nuance: The staleness gate compares `last_verified` against the registry mtime rather than against today, so a regenerated `concepts.json` refreshes every entry without anyone re-reading a claim.

nuance_evidence.control: regenerating the registry left the reported ages unchanged
nuance_evidence.falsifier: a regeneration changing a reported age
nuance_evidence.probe: unprobed: authored adversarially; the mechanism described here is not the one implemented

negatives.title: Gate registration
negatives.summary: Where a new gate must be registered.
negatives.nuance: A gate registered only in the `--check` dispatcher never runs in the main sequence, so `audit-gates.sh` reports a pass that covers no assertion at all.

nuance_evidence.control: a dispatcher-only fixture gate was absent from the full-suite output
nuance_evidence.falsifier: a dispatcher-only gate appearing in the suite summary
nuance_evidence.probe: unprobed: authored adversarially; true but stated in the gate own header, so it teaches nothing new
